segments.he: עַל יְדֵי אֲמִירַת תְּהִלִּים תִּהְיֶה הַגְּאֻלָּה הַשְּׁלֵמָה
segments.en: The essential strengthening is through the will [ratzon] — however things befall one at any time, however one is — in any case one must strengthen oneself with a very strong will for G-d, and in any case long and yearn to return to G-d from wherever one may be. For ultimately what will remain of him? And especially since the true Tzaddikim have already revealed to us that the good will in itself is very precious and valued — and this is the aspect of the ultimate final purpose, the aspect of: "How great is Your goodness" [Tehillim 31:20]. Therefore one must always strengthen oneself at all times with a strong will for G-d from wherever one is — through which one will be aroused and strengthened to pray always to G-d, and to multiply the saying of Tehillim and supplications and many requests that G-d have mercy on him and draw down upon him the true compassion of the true Leader — which is the aspect of "for with compassion He will lead them" [Yeshayahu 49:10]. Until one merits to emerge from the spirit of folly — and especially to multiply hisbodidus, which is conversation and prayer between oneself and one's Creator — until one pours one's heart like water before G-d — until G-d looks down and sees from heaven, and shines upon him the holy daas to nullify the spirit of folly — until one emerges and returns from all transgressions and merits to draw close to G-d in truth. For this prayer is the aspect of fear [yirah] — the aspect of "what does Hashem your G-d ask of you — but to fear" [Devarim 10:12] — which is the aspect of prayer, the aspect of "the woman who fears Hashem shall be praised" [Mishlei 31:30].

segments.he: כְּלַל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה שֶׁעִקַּר הַהִתְרַחֲקוּת מֵהַתְּשׁוּבָה הוּא מֵחֲמַת שֶׁצְּרִיכִין שֶׁאָנוּ נִתְעוֹרֵר לָשׁוּב אֵלָיו וְהַהִתְעוֹרְרוּת כָּרָאוּי קָשָׁה מְאד. וּבִפְרָט לְמִי שֶׁכְּבָר נִתְרַחֵק וְעָשָׂה מַה שֶּׁעָשָׂה. וְאַף עַל פִּי כֵן הַכּל חֲפֵצִים לְיִרְאָה שְׁמוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ אַךְ קָשֶׁה וְכָבֵד לָהֶם לְהִתְעוֹרֵר וְכֻלָּם רוֹצִים שֶׁה' יִתְבָּרַךְ יְעוֹרֵר אוֹתָם וְיַחֲזִירֵם לְמוּטָב. אֲבָל כְּשֶׁיּוֹדְעִים וּמַאֲמִינִים בְּהָאֱמֶת שֶׁה' יִתְבָּרַךְ בּוֹחֵר בָּזֶה בְּעַצְמוֹ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה רְצוֹנֵנוּ וְחֶפְצֵנוּ תָּמִיד לְהִתְקָרֵב אֵלָיו. וְשֶׁאֵין אָנוּ צְרִיכִין רַק לִקַּח דְּבָרִים וְלָשׁוּב אֵלָיו כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (הוֹשֵׁעַ י"ד) קְחוּ עִמָּכֶם דְּבָרִים וְשׁוּבוּ אֶל ה'. וְדָרְשׁוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה אֵינִי מְבַקֵּשׁ מִכֶּם אֶלָּא דְּבָרִים. וּבֶאֱמֶת גַּם הַדִּבּוּרִים בְּעַצְמוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ יִתְבָּרַךְ רַק שֶׁאָנוּ צְרִיכִין לְהִשְׁתַּדֵּל לִקַּח אוֹתָם עִמָּנוּ וּלְדַבֵּר בָּהֶם לְפָנָיו יִתְבָּרַךְ. וְזֶהוּ קְחוּ עִמָּכֶם דְּבָרִים. קְחוּ דַּיְקָא. הַיְנוּ שֶׁהַדְּבָרִים כְּבָר מוּכָנִים מֵאִתּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְה' יִתְבָּרַךְ מְבַקֵּשׁ שֶׁנִּקַּח אוֹתָם עִמָּנוּ לָשׁוּב אֵלָיו עַל יְדֵי זֶה. וּכְמוֹ שֶׁמְּפָרֵשׁ וּמְלַמֵּד אוֹתָנוּ שָׁם אֵיךְ נאמַר לְפָנָיו כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב שָׁם אִמְרוּ אֵלָיו כּל תִּשָּׂא עָוֹן וְכוּ'. וּמִי שֶׁיֵּדַע כָּל זאת בֶּאֱמֶת בְּוַדַּאי בְּקַל יָשׁוּב לַה' יִתְבָּרַךְ מִכָּל מָקוֹם שֶׁהוּא אֲפִלּוּ אִם יַעֲבר עָלָיו מָה. כִּי תָּמִיד יוּכַל לִקַּח דִּבּוּרִים מֵאִתּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ אִם יִרְצֶה עַד אֲשֶׁר סוֹף כָּל סוֹף יָשׁוּב אֵלָיו וִירַחֲמֵהוּ. וְזֶהוּ בְּחִינַת גּדֶל מַעֲלַת אֲמִירַת תְּהִלִּים שֶׁגִּלָּה הוּא זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה בְּוַדַּאי נִזְכֶּה לִתְשׁוּבָה. וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה תִּהְיֶה הַגְּאֻלָּה שְׁלֵמָה בִּמְהֵרָה בְּיָמֵינוּ כָּל זְמַן שֶׁנַּעֲסֹק בַּאֲמִירַת תְּהִלִּים בְּכַוָּנָה לְהַשְׁמִיעַ אָזְנוֹ וְלִבּוֹ לְמַה שֶּׁאוֹמֵר, בְּוַדַּאי יָשׁוּב לַה' יִתְבָּרַךְ.
segments.en: And this is: "Though a camp encamp against me, my heart shall not fear; though war should rise against me — in this do I trust. One thing I asked of Hashem — that shall I seek: that I dwell in the house of Hashem all the days of my life, to behold the pleasantness of Hashem" [Tehillim 27:3-4]. That is: the essential victory in the war of this world is through the remozim [hints/sparks] that are the aspect of the illumination of the will — "for even so, I desire the truth." As is explained in our discussions many times. And this is explained in the juxtaposition of the above verses — that Dovid said: "Though a camp encamp against me, my heart shall not fear; though war should rise against me — in this do I trust." And he proceeds to explain: what is the "this" in which he trusts? It is: "One thing I asked of Hashem — that shall I seek: that I dwell in the house of Hashem all the days of my life" — that he merit to dwell in the house of G-d — which is the holy will. And since all my desire is only for this, and all my asking and requesting all the days of my life is only this — in this do I trust in all the wars that rise against me, and all the camps that encamp around me from every side — even so I do not fear them. For I trust in this — the strengthening of the holy will that I strengthen myself in at all times. For through this G-d will help me to defeat them and break them. For the essential victory in war is through the holy will.

segments.he: כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת הַכּל מֵאִתּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ וְאֵין ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ חָפֵץ רַק הָרָצוֹן וְהַהִתְעוֹרְרוּת וְהַהִשְׁתַּדְּלוּת אַחַר הָאֱמֶת כִּי בְּלִי שׁוּם הִתְעוֹרְרוּת כְּלָל אִי אֶפְשָׁר. אֲבָל בֶּאֱמֶת הַכּל מֵאִתּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ.
segments.en: The essential strengthening is through believing in the above holy knowledge — that "the whole earth is full of His glory". But as soon as difficulties come upon one — even when it is hard for him on account of himself, because even so he is so blemished and so far from the holiness of the Torah — immediately one must flee from all those difficulties and be silent in one's thought and fulfill: "the best safeguard for wisdom is silence." Rather, to strengthen oneself each time to snatch whatever good points one can — Torah and mitzvos, and especially prayer and supplications and conversation before one's Creator — and not to look at whatever befalls one. For one must be a great obstinate person in the service of G-d, for no one knows at all. Only to fulfill what our Rebbe, of blessed memory, commanded us — that there is no despair in the world at all. For His greatness is without limit. And as we have spoken of this in many places. Turn it over and turn it over [i.e., study it repeatedly] — for they are your life eternally.

And this is the aspect of the reversed nuns in Psalm 107 [Hodu] in Tehillim — which speaks of all the exiles into which the Knesses Yisrael fell, whose rectification is through the aspect of the nun of Moshiach. These are the aspect of the true Tzaddikim of each generation — who implant in Israel the will to cry out at every time to G-d and to give thanks to Him for His kindnesses and wonders that He does with us at every time, amidst the depth of the bitterness of troubles in body and soul and money. And likewise, to cry and return and cry — in the manner of "and they cried and they cried," as is cited much in our discussions.

Only to fulfill what our Rebbe, of blessed memory, commanded us — that there is no despair in the world at all. For His greatness is without limit. And as we have spoken of this in many places. Turn it over and turn it over [i.e., study it repeatedly] — for they are your life eternally.

And this is the aspect of the reversed nuns in Psalm 107 [Hodu] in Tehillim — which speaks of all the exiles into which the Knesses Yisrael fell, whose rectification is through the aspect of the nun of Moshiach. These are the aspect of the true Tzaddikim of each generation — who implant in Israel the will to cry out at every time to G-d and to give thanks to Him for His kindnesses and wonders that He does with us at every time, amidst the depth of the bitterness of troubles in body and soul and money. And likewise, to cry and return and cry — in the manner of "and they cried and they cried," as is cited much in our discussions.
